name: a11y-target-size-measure
description: Measures every pointer target on every page at mobile and desktop viewports against WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 24 by 24 CSS pixels, with a Playwright script that applies the spacing exception's 24 px circle test exactly, then classifies remaining candidates against the inline, equivalent, user agent control and essential exceptions.
